name: writfold
description: Git-native project continuity: a KB brief at session start, local checkpoint drafts at compaction and stop, a skill teaching the writfold kb verbs, and a writfold:evaluate skill that closes a run with a reflection. Needs the writfold binary on PATH.

kb_root.title: KB root
kb_root.description: The project KB (the directory holding inventory/assets/). Leave empty to use $WRITFOLD_KB or the nearest KB above the session's directory.

posture.title: Guard posture
posture.description: What a tool call gets when the guard cannot decide it (no KB, a rule file that does not parse, a required rule missing, the 8 s deadline, writfold not on PATH): open (default: it passes, as before), ask or deny. A guard, not enforcement.
